bullets: Hover tips: point at a button, or reach it with Tab, and a small box says what it does. Single, Council, Mission, the priority and timing choices, and every page in the sidebar have one.
Simple chat: after you send, the box folds to one line, so the answer has more room and Copy, Try again and Finish stay in view.
Simple shows all ten choices on a wide screen, including Spreadsheet, Document, Slides, App or script, and List or data.
Use this in Prompts puts the words in the chat box in Simple, ready to send.
Messages that pop up no longer cover your answer. On a phone the dock scrolls, with Chat first.
The Saved this month pill is easier to read in light mode, and the savings card updates when a job finishes.
Expert gives the answer the full width when the side column would be too narrow.
A page that does not load says so after 8 seconds and offers Try again.
Practice mode now makes real spreadsheets and lists, so you can try those choices without a key.
